name: Long-context depth sweep, 1k to 256k
description: Decode speed and prefill time as a function of prompt length: 1k, 4k, 8k, 16k, 32k, 64k, 128k and 256k input tokens, 256 output tokens, one stream. Every point also asks for a needle placed at 90 % depth, so a run cannot report a fast number for a context the model was not actually reading.
notes: A point whose input exceeds the served max-model-len is recorded as a failed point with failure category context-overflow, not omitted. A wrong needle answer counts as a failed request (it lowers success_rate) and adds a failures[] entry with category malformed-output. Hand-recorded runs may report other points along the same axis; the list above is what a harness run walks.
